recentItems.description:

The Green Archers had to weather a Toper Lagat-led rally before escaping the Red Warriors in overtime, 97-88, in UAAP Season 89 on Wednesday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.

recentItems.title: Pope Leo takes to popemobile for first time since cancer surgery
recentItems.description:
Pope Leo returned to St. Peter's Square on Wednesday (October 21), waving to pilgrims and blessing babies from his open-air popemobile as he held his first general audience at the Vatican since undergoing lung cancer surgery eight days ago.

The 71-year-old pontiff, who pledged on Sunday he would slowly resume his duties as leader of the world's 1.4 billion Catholics, stood in the back of the vehicle as it drove through the square, waving, smiling and stopping to talk to pilgrims.

Leo had the lower lobe of his right lung removed in surgery on October 13 and has been diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer.

The diagnosis, for the youngest pope in decades who was elected only in May 2025, caused shock and raised questions about the future shape of his papacy.

Wednesday's audience, the first held by the pope since October 7, followed a normal format. Crowds began gathering hours ahead of the 9:45 a.m. (0745 GMT) starting time, holding umbrellas under drizzling grey skies.

"The first thing I want to say to you is thank you for the support and prayers," Leo told the crowds in his opening remarks for the 50-minute event, without specifically mentioning his health.

"Thanks be to God for his generosity," said the pope, speaking in a clear voice as cheers broke out in the Square. "Let's renew our trust in the goodness and mercy of God." — Reuters

(Production: Oriana Boselli ; Writing: Joshua McElwee)

recentItems.title: #RosalPH unti-unti nang humihina
recentItems.description:
Unti-unti nang naoobserbahan ang paghina ng super typhoon "Rosal" habang binabagtas nito ang Philippine Sea, ayon sa 5 p.m. weather advisory ng PAGASA nitong Miyerkoles, Oktubre 21.

Huling namataan ang bagyo 725 kilometro sa silangan ng Aparri, Cagayan at gumagalaw patungo sa direksyong kanluran-hilagang kanluran sa bilis na 25 kph.

Itinaas na ang Signal No. 2 sa Batanes at nananatili namang nasa Signal No. 1 ang Cagayan (including Babuyan Islands), Eastern Isabela, Apayao, Ilocos Norte, at Northeastern Catanduanes. — Ulat ni Ariel Rojas, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: Bakit 'edukado'? Robin ipinaliwanag ang pahayag ukol kay Jing Quan
recentItems.description:
Sa isang panayam nitong Miyerkoles (Oktubre 21), ipinaliwanag ni Sen. Robin Padilla kung bakit niya natawag na "edukado" at "gentleman" si Chinese ambassador Jing Quan sa gitna ng kinakaharap nitong kontrobersya kaugnay ng pahayag niya sa paggamit ng puwersa ng Tsina sa West Philippine Sea.

Aniya, base lamang iyon sa karanasan niya nang makausap nang personal si Quan – bagay na hinikayat niya ring gawin ng ibang opisyal ng gobyerno na nagkomento sa nasabing isyu.
